system.description:
ARCHIVIST SOUL UTILITY WARDING
Archivist Specialist Spell
Cast R (verbal)
Trigger: A living creature within 30 feet dies
Range 30 feet
Targets the triggering creature
Duration 10 minutes

At the instant of death, you bind the departing soul gently to the remains, preventing outside forces from claiming it.
For the duration:
the soul cannot be forcibly removed, destroyed, possessed or bound unless the effect first successfully Counteracts Anchor the Departing Soul;
the corpse cannot be animated by an effect that requires or manipulates the deceased creature's soul unless the spell is first Counteracted;
the creature remains a valid target for magic capable of returning it to life; and
time spent under Anchor the Departing Soul does not count towards ordinary limits based upon the number of minutes, hours or days since death.
The final benefit does not extend effects whose requirements refer specifically to death occurring during the current round, previous round or another explicitly combat-timed window.
The soul may willingly depart where another rule permits it to make that choice.

Warping Options:
+2 PP: Increase the duration to 1 hour.
+4 PP: Increase the duration to 24 hours.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10.
